decision_note: Deterministic capture/replay accepted as benchmark infrastructure; it removes route-dependent work variance. The 8-lane retrial inside it shows a cold-phase-only benefit: +12.4% first-32 with flat last-32, so eight lanes are a cold-start profile, not a sustained speedup.

Deterministic fixed-workload retrial attributes the earlier gain entirely to the cache-fill phase: warm-window speed is unchanged and the +3% sustained bar is not met. Rejected as a general speedup; --io-threads 8 stays available as a cold-start profile for short interactive bmoe-cli runs. The interactive server runs the separate expert-tier binary and is unaffected.

The 14-15 interactive observation is the distinct-prompt band; repeated-prompt peaks at 18.09. True cold start is a 1 tok/s cliff with silent 435 MiB process swap. This is the new practical baseline for Qwen3.8.
